title: Concept: Lockfile resolved a prerelease build
description: package-lock.json declares a resolved version that is a prerelease build, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Prerelease builds sit outside most advisory ranges and outside the stability promises the project tested against.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: Prerelease builds sit outside most advisory ranges and outside the stability promises the project tested against.
